versions.changelog:
- Updated skill name from "openclaw-health-monitor" to "openclaw-health-monitor" in documentation for consistency.
- Bumped version to 1.6.0.
- Expanded diagnostic bundle documentation: now explicitly lists collected data (health snapshots, log metadata, config structure), warns about sensitive content, and describes log tail extraction (optionally and disabled by default).
- Clarified guidance about reviewing exported diagnostic bundles before sharing for privacy.
- No new features or behavioral changes; documentation-only update focused on diagnostic data transparency.
v1.5.3: update display name to OpenClaw Health Monitor
v1.5.2: fix README skill install command slug
v1.5.1: remove dead config keys from README config table
v1.5.0: cross-platform rewrite, API fix, security defaults, complete rename
v1.3.0: Updated cross-platform prerequisites, renamed Known Issues, added Telegram to alert descriptions, fixed section numbering, added health dashboard
1.2.0: Cross-platform support for Linux and macOS. Removed Windows-only restriction. Platform-aware health probes. Updated documentation for all platforms.

Initial release of Windows Health Monitor for OpenClaw.

- Diagnose and resolve common Windows-specific OpenClaw issues (gateway health, event loop degradation, WhatsApp connectivity, scheduled tasks, and more).
- Provides quick health check instructions and key metrics for troubleshooting.
- Includes standard diagnostic scripts and log search patterns for identifying stuck processes and performance bottlenecks.
- Describes known issues and fixes after upgrades, npm reinstalls, or plugin/config changes.
- Bundles tools for generating sanitized diagnostic reports for support and bug reports.
- Outlines integration steps with the OpenClaw WinHealth plugin for automated background monitoring.
